summary: This chunk is a diff adding a new file, skills/debug-loop/SKILL.md, a 254-line skill definition for a 'Debug Loop' agent workflow. It defines a two-stage process: first turning a bug report into a structured 'Debug Brief' (symptom, repro, check, ranked hypotheses), then running a verification-gated loop that reproduces the bug, commits a failing test, instruments code, changes one variable at a time, verifies the fix, and resets to a handoff block if the loop stalls. It includes a fast path for obvious one-line bugs and references a separate tactics.md file for advanced cases.

claims.text: The skill supersedes an existing 'diagnose' skill and should run alone when both match
Step 0 requires four facts before reading implementation code: exact symptom, a repro, a check, and a scope hint
Step 1a fast path applies only when error names a specific file/line, that line explains the failure, and the fix touches only one place
Step 2 requires committing a failing test before writing any fix, overriding the default 'commit only when asked' behavior
Step 5 requires reverting the fix once to confirm the check goes red again, except when the check takes minutes or Step 3 already proved the link
Step 6 requires stopping and handing off after two failed fixes on the same issue, with a handoff block telling the user to run /clear
/rewind checkpoints only track edits made through file-editing tools, not shell command changes
references/tactics.md covers git bisect, hooks that run tests after every edit, subagent delegation cost, and overfitting checks
